consequence.statement: Existing policies keep nested variable substitution unless they adopt the new notation; using `{{- ... }}` limits substitution to one pass so Kyverno does not attempt to resolve `{{ }}` content inside the substituted data (e.g. an HCL string from a ConfigMap).
consequence.remediation: Where substituted rule data contains `{{ }}` that Kyverno must not resolve, use the `{{- ... }}` declaration (e.g. `{{- hcl }}`) for shallow substitution.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a `{{- ... }}` notation for shallow (one-time) variable substitution, letting a policy substitute rule data (e.g. an HCL string defined in a ConfigMap) without Kyverno attempting to resolve the nested `{{ }}` variables inside it.
